We need to compare two statements. Both are about "Regulamentação do trabalho de motoristas de aplicativo" (regulation of app drivers). Both are public hearings, dates March 21 and April 25 2024. Both speakers are presumably same actor (same person) but blinded. Need to see if they respond to same specific proposition (bill) with same stance direction.

Manifestação A: speaker criticizes the government bill (projeto de lei) presented, says it's similar to CLT but without rights, wants total rejection ("rejeição total desse projeto"). Also mentions they are campaigning for rejection.

Manifestação B: speaker also criticizes the same bill? Refers to "Projeto de Lei Complementar nº 12" (PLP 12) and says motorists reject it >98%, wants rejection of this project as presented, and wants new text PL 536/24. So stance is also against the government bill (PLP 12). Both are against same specific proposition (the government bill). Both are FAVOR? Actually stance direction: they are AGAINST the bill. So both same stance (AGAINST). So STANCE_MAINTAINED.

Check if any nuance: In A, they say "rejeição total desse projeto". In B, they say "rejeitem este projeto em vista de como ele se apresenta". Same. So same proposition, same stance.

Thus relation = STANCE_MAINTAINED.
